# Ummah Apps

> Ummah Apps (تطبيقات للأمة) makes apps for Muslim families, for memorising the Qur'an, learning the Seerah and Arabic, exploring nature, managing money the Islamic way and keeping track of a family tree. URL: https://ummahapps.ai/

## Hifdh

- [Hifdh Helper](https://hifdh-helper.ummahapps.ai/): Qur'an memorisation tracker with daily targets, spaced repetition revision and a full revision cycle.

## Kids

- [Kids Qur'an](https://kids-quran.ummahapps.ai/): helps children memorise Al-Fatiha, Ayatul Kursi, Al-Insan and short surahs, with recitation, repeat, slow mode and English translation.
- [Takallum Kids](https://takallum-kids.ummahapps.ai/): Arabic speaking practice for children aged 4 to 11.
- [Learn the Seerah](https://seerah.ummahapps.ai/): learn the life of the Prophet through the Seerah Song by Zain Bikha, line by line.
- [Nature Spotters](https://nature-spotters.ummahapps.ai/): a nature journal for children and families.

## Arabic

- [Kalimat](https://kalimat.ummahapps.ai/): 900+ everyday Arabic words and 540 Qur'an words, with harakat, audio, plurals and games, for beginners.
- [Takallum](https://takallum.ummahapps.ai/): Modern Standard Arabic speaking drills (900+ sentences, including GCSE Arabic speaking topics), transformation chains and role-plays.
- [Kalimat Plus](https://kalimat-plus.ummahapps.ai/): 470+ Fusha words and phrases for intermediate learners, on worship, tarbiyyah, character, the environment and GCSE Arabic (Pearson Edexcel) topics.

## Family and finance

- [Hisab](https://hisab.ummahapps.ai/): Islamic finance app for sadaqa, zakat, fidyah, loans, faraid and an Islamic will.
- [Al Ansab](https://alansab.app/): a private family tree built around nasab, mahram, fara'id and remembering elders.
